critical_code_review_comments: reports_scheduler imports motor + opens an AsyncIOMotorClient at module-import time (line 20-21). That couples test/dev usability to a valid MONGO_URL being present at import. Tests had to strip quoted env values manually. Consider lazy DB-client construction (build inside _tick) so the module imports cleanly without DB env set.

SSE endpoint /api/notifications/stream accepts JWT via ?token= query param. Token will appear in proxy/nginx access logs and browser history — acceptable trade-off for EventSource limitation, but worth noting for production logging policy (consider scrubbing the token query param from access logs).

SSE polling interval is 1s with a DB query each tick. For N concurrent SSE clients this is N qps per second on db.notifications. Currently fine, but a change-stream or pub/sub bus would scale better if many users connect.
